_note: Source of truth for the Impressum identity block. site/legal-data.js comes from the design-tool export and is wiped on every deploy, so these values are re-applied by seo/apply_legal.py (deploy.sh: apply_legal). Never edit site/legal-data.js.
_blocked: identity.street and identity.zip are REQUIRED. While either is empty the layer refuses to run and the export's [bracketed] placeholders stay visible — an honest placeholder beats an invented address. Selling to German buyers behind a placeholder Impressum is a § 5 DDG defect (Abmahnung risk), so fill these in before the Stripe go-live.
_vat_mode: One of: 'vat_id' (you have a USt-IdNr. — fill vat.id), 'kleinunternehmer' (§ 19 UStG small-business rule, no VAT charged), or '' (layer refuses to run).
_langs: Per-language templates. {street} {zip} {city} {vat_id} are substituted. 'sub' replaces the imprint subtitle; 'provider' replaces imprint section 0; 'vat_id'/'kleinunternehmer' replace imprint section 2 depending on vat.mode. A language may override 'city' (Arabic does, to keep the city name in Arabic script).

en.sub: Information pursuant to § 5 DDG (German Digital Services Act)
en.vat_id: VAT identification number pursuant to § 27a German VAT Act: {vat_id}
en.kleinunternehmer: Under § 19 of the German VAT Act (small-business rule) no VAT is charged, so no VAT identification number is issued.

de.kleinunternehmer: Gemäß § 19 UStG (Kleinunternehmerregelung) wird keine Umsatzsteuer berechnet; eine Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer liegt daher nicht vor.

fr.kleinunternehmer: En application du § 19 de la loi allemande sur la TVA (régime des petites entreprises), aucune TVA n'est facturée et aucun numéro de TVA n'est attribué.

ro.kleinunternehmer: Conform § 19 UStG (regimul întreprinderilor mici din Germania) nu se percepe TVA, prin urmare nu există un număr de identificare TVA.

ar.kleinunternehmer: بموجب المادة 19 من قانون ضريبة القيمة المضافة الألماني (نظام المنشآت الصغيرة) لا تُحتسب ضريبة قيمة مضافة، ولذلك لا يوجد رقم تعريف ضريبي.

_steuernummer: Optional. § 5 DDG requires the USt-IdNr., not the Steuernummer, so this line is a courtesy, not a legal duty. Set it to "" to drop it from all 5 languages.
